answer_2.quote: We select pass@1 accuracy as our primary metric because it is straightforward and widely used for evaluating multiple-choice and prediction-based causal tasks... We also report accuracy, F1, precision, recall, AUC, BLEU, ROUGE-L, Perplexity, and Causal Explanation Quality (CEQ).

answer_4.quote: We assess human performance on each dataset... we asked three graduate students to solve 100 randomly selected problems from each dataset. Prior to the evaluation, the participants underwent training... their average accuracy is calculated as the final result.
answer_4.guideline: Participants solved the selected problems independently after training; their answers were compared to the correct ones to compute average accuracy.
